name: Ablution
overview: Scripture highlights ablution as an important practice signifying purification and hospitality, as seen when water is provided for washing feet in Genesis 18, 19, 24, and 43, demonstrating care and respect for guests. Additionally, ablution extends to sanctification, as God commands the people to wash their clothes for holiness in Exodus 19, emphasizing outward cleansing as a symbol of inward consecration. These passages collectively show ablution as both a practical and spiritual act within the biblical narrative.
